news.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
news.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

news.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
news.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

news.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
news.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?

news.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
news.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

news.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
news.summary: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.

news.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
news.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

news.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
news.summary: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

news.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
news.summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

news.title: The data is very preliminary, but Vulcan failure may not be due to BE-4 engines
news.summary: Information about the Vulcan failure is being closely held by ULA and Blue Origin.
